what: A small dot pin on a map or photo stretches into a pill as wide as its name on hover — the wrapper width goes from dot size (36px) to name width in .8s, the pill body goes from half size (around the dot center) to full size in .8s (cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)), the name comes in .5s later over .4s linear, and the ring around the dot turns on in .4s. On leave the name fades right away in .4s and the pill folds back with the same curve.

options.[data-fx-part=body]: Required pill body (a box holding a dot + name side by side)
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Dot graphic (svg, optional) — inside [data-fx-part=ring] If a ring is placed, it lights up on hover
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Required name — its width is measured and set in --fx-w

from.where: index.html .cz-pin (original #pins-w .pin — max-width 36px → var(--width) .8s, >div scale3d(.5,.5,.5) → 1 .8s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1), span and ring opacity .4s linear (name .5s later))
